00eff3d9ec9b.en: **Kozaku Forway** (931) — legendary boss of the Blue Wozens; not seen in ages.
00eff3d9ec9b.t: **小作·福威**（931）——布卢沃增斯的传奇首领；已经很久没人见过他。

09bf6ba02141.en: **Biny Forway Cliff-Jumper** (994) — ex-Black Castle clerk who invests in adventurers for 30% of their quests and leaks the best quests early.
09bf6ba02141.t: **比尼·福威·克利夫贾珀**（994）——前黑城堡职员，以分得委托收益的30%为条件投资冒险者，还会提前泄露最好的委托。

1d319f21dfee.en: **Kaiana Forway Cliff-Jumper** (1014) — calls herself the "Quick-Witted White Caster" (QWWC is sewn on her uniform); everyone else calls her the "Angry White Caster with Double D". Loud, drunk, punctual, reliable; parties tend to disband around her.
1d319f21dfee.t: **凯阿娜·福威·克利夫贾珀**（1014）——自称“机智的白色施法者”（制服上缝着QWWC）；其他人都叫她“带双D的暴躁白色施法者”。吵闹、爱喝酒、守时、可靠；队伍往往在她身边解散。

1d594ae5f462.en: **Maicon Crossroads Black-Dove** (1011) — frequents every illegal establishment and holds blackmail on everyone. Ruffle him and the dirt flies all the way to Newland.
1d594ae5f462.t: **迈孔·克罗斯罗兹·布莱克达夫**（1011）——出入每一家非法场所，手里握着所有人的把柄。惹毛了他，黑料会一路飞到纽兰。

1efba2441eaa.en: **Fernan Blood Blue-Flower-Red-Bone** (994) — Sapphire bow hero of Tastyleaf with statues in Blood and Tastyleaf; officially died on a Hifuna mission.
1efba2441eaa.t: **费尔南·布拉德·布卢-弗劳尔-雷德-博恩**（994）——泰斯蒂利夫的萨菲尔弓箭英雄，布拉德和泰斯蒂利夫都有他的雕像；官方说法是死于一次希富纳任务。

2e9e94b008fd.en: **King Nooru High-Gandew Tough-Hammer** (919) — the friendliest king Gandew has ever had; strangely always missing one tusk. **Queen Satomi** (949) — xenophobic, hardworking, gifted blacksmith.
2e9e94b008fd.t: **努鲁·高甘杜·塔夫哈默国王**（919）——甘杜有史以来最友善的国王；奇怪的是总缺一根獠牙。**里美王后**（949）——排外、勤劳、天赋异禀的铁匠。

3afae90d20f0.t: 村长们：**图皮南巴**（格林海）、**曼波拉**（德波因特）、**托马尼乌斯**（朗布里奇）。

3b7c56bdbdba.en: **Sora Sanbi Blue-Glass** (1025) — shy Wozefaries maid with a genius for finances; her parents run a soap shop.
3b7c56bdbdba.t: **索拉·桑比·布卢格拉斯**（1025）——害羞的沃泽法里斯女仆，在财务上是个天才；她的父母开了一家肥皂店。

3e45a5cf5500.en: **Emelia Lakeeye Rich-Flower** (1018) — owner of Emelia's Flowery Paradise; nobody's sure where her money comes from.
3e45a5cf5500.t: **艾米莉娅·莱克艾·里奇弗劳尔**（1018）——艾米莉娅的花之乐园的老板；没人确定她的钱是从哪儿来的。

42225118861c.en: **Namia Sundeath** (1015) — quiet woman from Sundeath's servant families; rumored nari-gel abuser who wears animal bodies. Often mistaken for the Queen.
42225118861c.t: **娜米娅·桑德斯**（1015）——出身桑德斯仆役家族的安静女子；传说她滥用纳里凝胶，穿着动物的身体。常被误认为王后。

42cafa37dda3.en: **Eiri Sanbi Royal** (1017) — playful, lewd King-Maid and accountant-chef; daughter of the former King-Maid **Coema Half-Cruro** (987), who hunted tax evaders with Cruro help and sailed off to Newland.
42cafa37dda3.t: **艾莉·桑比·罗亚尔**（1017）——爱玩又好色的金梅德，兼会计和厨师；前任金梅德**科埃玛·哈夫·克鲁罗**（987）的女儿，科埃玛曾借助克鲁罗追捕逃税者，后来扬帆去了纽兰。

5079da27d2e1.en: **Akemi** (1004) — his widow, a Wozefaries librarian into the occult; their son **Jonem** (1029) wants to be a historian; their daughter **Magi** (1020) is a narcoleptic Pearl adventurer hunting for her father and paying off the guild's debts.
5079da27d2e1.t: **明美**（1004）——他的遗孀，一位痴迷神秘学的沃泽法里斯图书管理员；他们的儿子**乔内姆**（1029）想当历史学家；女儿**玛姬**（1020）是一名患有嗜睡症的珀尔级冒险者，一边寻找父亲，一边偿还公会的债务。

526abc61ac79.en: **Morika Tolerideme** (1014) — a quiet, ripped, submissive Toleridemian (rare!) who won't say where he lives now. Separately, people whisper about **"The Stinger"**, a gore-soaked figure in insect-like armor seen wandering the wilds.
526abc61ac79.t: **莫里卡·托勒里德梅**（1014）——一个安静、肌肉发达、顺从的托勒里德梅人（很少见！），不肯说他现在住在哪里。另外，人们私下议论着 **“斯廷格”**，一个浑身浴血、穿着昆虫般盔甲的身影，有人看到它在荒野中游荡。

533166b52b4f.en: **Kibe Sanbi Royal** (989) — orphan apprentice of the late courtroom scientist **Gabiro**; gets things "technically done"; terrible public speaker.
533166b52b4f.t: **基贝·桑比·罗亚尔**（989）——已故宫廷科学家**加比罗**的孤儿学徒；能把事情“从技术上讲”办完；极不擅长公开演讲。

57daacbdc3e9.en: **Laura Forway White-Bell** (b. 1009) — rags-to-riches former courtesan who now controls Forway's brothels through proxies and owns a homestead known for "parties". Rumored to be behind Red Winga.
57daacbdc3e9.t: **劳拉·福威·怀特贝尔**（生于1009年）——白手起家的前交际花，如今通过代理人控制着福威的妓院，还拥有一座以“派对”闻名的庄园。传说她是雷德温加的幕后黑手。

5d7b4f125bc4.en: **King Itagiba Sanbi Royal** (994) — approachable king who stops to drink with anyone having fun. Explored the world in his youth (maybe left a few kids). Do not mess with his daughters.
5d7b4f125bc4.t: **伊塔吉巴·桑比·罗亚尔国王**（994）——平易近人的国王，看到有人玩得开心就会停下来一起喝。年轻时周游过世界（也许留下了几个孩子）。别招惹他的女儿们。

6087bc06f7d5.en: **Kiko Sanbi Half-Cruro** (1018) — Cruro entrepreneur who founded the Half-Cruro guild. His assistant **Zico** (1023) walks Sanbi every day scribbling in a journal to chat; "you haven't been to Sanbi until you've said hi to Zico".
6087bc06f7d5.t: **基科·桑比·哈夫·克鲁罗**（1018）——创立哈夫·克鲁罗公会的克鲁罗企业家。他的助手**济科**（1023）每天在桑比四处走动，在日记本上涂涂写写来找人聊天；“没跟济科打过招呼，就不算来过桑比”。

726b661388fa.en: **Francisco Forway Tea-Drinkers** (857) — Darfaries who lost his family in a Gandew dungeon party, hit bottom, and found a family in the Tea-Drinkers guild. Father of **Takeo** (969), a curt, quiet giant (human, though he looks Darfaries). He's polite up to a point, but he has a dark side: he "questions" suspects with a finger-clipping tool.
726b661388fa.t: **弗朗西斯科·福威·蒂德林克斯**（857）——在甘杜的一场地牢派对中失去家人的达尔法里斯，跌入谷底后，在蒂德林克斯公会找到了新的家庭。他是**武雄**（969）的父亲，武雄是个寡言少语的大个子（是人类，虽然看起来像达尔法里斯）。他在一定程度上很有礼貌，但有黑暗的一面：他会用一把剪手指的工具“审问”嫌疑人。

7302849efe21.en: **Pharaoh Gamal** (974) and his sister-wife **Naunet** (989; "the Neferteri of the West"); their twin sons **Anpu and Bata** (995), who refuse to rule unless they can share the throne.
7302849efe21.t: **法老贾迈勒**（974）和他的妹妹兼妻子**瑙内特**（989；“西方的奈菲尔特丽”）；他们的双胞胎儿子**安普和巴塔**（995），除非能共享王位，否则拒绝统治。

764ae0b3ca2e.en: **Freeish Paulin** (rebel, 621–648), **Asa the Powerful**, **Adrian from North Tolerideme**, **Bijura Moacir** (614–696) — the treaty founders; **Julina Forway** (855–895); the **Three Smart Ladies** (Evedyn, Everyn, Evelyn); **Machado** (the Ganyrami Flanker); **Gabiro Sanbi Royal** (937–1039), the great and aloof soul scientist.
764ae0b3ca2e.t: **弗里伊什·保林**（反抗者，621–648）、**阿萨·帕瓦富尔**、**北托勒里德梅的阿德里安**、**比茹拉·莫阿西尔**（614–696）——条约的创立者；**朱莉娜·福威**（855–895）；**三位聪慧女士**（伊芙丁、伊芙琳、伊芙林）；**马沙多**（加尼拉米侧翼兵）；**加比罗·桑比·罗亚尔**（937–1039），伟大而孤高的灵魂科学家。

7f1945c8c30d.en: **Queen Neferteri Sanbi Royal** (999) — runaway heir of Sundeath's Pharaohs; visionary and ambitious; has loyal followers everywhere.
7f1945c8c30d.t: **奈菲尔特丽·桑比·罗亚尔王后**（999）——桑德斯法老家族出逃的继承人；有远见又有野心；到处都有忠实的追随者。

8c7029de8624.en: **Huneo Sanbi Royal** (Sandour) (1016) — tiny, righteous Wozefaries captain of the guard from a rich Forway family who wants Sanbi to be "proper". Bribery rumors.
8c7029de8624.t: **胡内奥·桑比·罗亚尔**（桑杜尔）（1016）——出身福威富豪家族、个子小小又一身正气的沃泽法里斯卫队长，想让桑比变得“像样”。有受贿的传闻。

90627ec91dc0.en: **Jimmie Tolerideme Whoop-Ass** (997) — the Booze King: decisive, well connected, always reeking of booze, often found in a pile of big women. His recipe made his family rich. Partners **Kianna** (1004; ambitious, gullible to flattery) and **Isabel** (1011; the one who fixes their messes); kids **Ariana** (1034; hothead), **Amelia** (1036; laid-back, many friends) and **Brandi** (1039).
90627ec91dc0.t: **吉米·托勒里德梅·胡普阿斯**（997）——酒之王：果断、人脉广，总是一身酒气，常被人发现埋在一堆大块头女人中间。他的配方让家族发了财。伴侣是**琪安娜**（1004；有野心，一被奉承就上当）和**伊莎贝尔**（1011；专门收拾他们的烂摊子）；孩子是**阿丽亚娜**（1034；急脾气）、**阿米莉娅**（1036；随和，朋友多）和**布兰迪**（1039）。

979f1fabf6a9.en: **July Forway Tea-Drinkers** (1013) — the guild's youngest and best close-quarters fighter; inseparable from her Sayna **Mugi**. Don't pry into her past, and never feed her a nari gel.
979f1fabf6a9.t: **朱莉·福威·蒂德林克斯**（1013）——公会里年纪最小、近身战最强的成员；和她的赛纳**麦吉**形影不离。别打听她的过去，也绝对不要给她纳里凝胶。

9d2a00834ef4.en: **The Broken-Tree family** — traders **Laramy** (986) and **Honati** (998; illiterate bartender, fierce about her husband), their wanderlust daughter **Dalila** (1027), and cousin **Melada** (1007), a gambler trying to buy back her old life.
9d2a00834ef4.t: **布罗肯特里一家**——商人**拉勒米**（986）和**霍娜蒂**（998；不识字的酒馆老板娘，一涉及丈夫就很凶），他们热爱漫游的女儿**达莉拉**（1027），还有表亲**梅拉达**（1007），一个想把旧日生活赎回来的赌徒。

a62998da696f.en: **The Big-Gyut boys** — **Marcus** (997; wants to be boss), **Clodoveu** (984; daydreamer), **Wilson** (1019) — Blue Wozens bandits from Big Gyut village.
a62998da696f.t: **大久特村的小伙子们**——**马库斯**（997；想当老大）、**克洛多韦乌**（984；爱做白日梦）、**威尔逊**（1019）——来自大久特村的布卢沃增斯强盗。

b7ef7cba858c.en: **Prince Hiromi High-Gandew Tough-Hammer** (994) — a wanderer and drinker with endless stories (he's always the hero), engaged to Princess Yacamim.
b7ef7cba858c.t: **弘美·高甘杜·塔夫哈默王子**（994）——一个流浪者兼酒鬼，故事讲不完（主角永远是他自己），与娅卡敏公主订了婚。

ba43a586e968.en: **Tarou Mid-Gandew Strong-Leg** (899) — self-proclaimed "Forfaries" deal-maker; will throw money at any daring plan.
ba43a586e968.t: **太郎·中甘杜·斯特朗莱格**（899）——自封的“福法里斯”掮客；任何大胆的计划他都愿意砸钱。

d1aba74e4330.en: **Ryo Flatland Long-Blue** (974) — wealthy Wozefaries merchant drowning in debt: "Gotta spend someone else's balls to make yourself some balls!"
d1aba74e4330.t: **亮·弗拉特兰·朗布卢**（974）——深陷债务的富有沃泽法里斯商人：“得花别人的球，才能给自己赚到球！”

d9874cbb84e1.en: **Rebula village** — wood carver **Nailah** (1015), stern elder **Severino** (1007), dreamy son **Vitor** (1025).
d9874cbb84e1.t: **雷布拉村**——木雕师**奈拉**（1015）、严厉的长老**塞韦里诺**（1007）、爱做梦的儿子**维托尔**（1025）。

db15eca394d5.en: **Lofinghy Sanbi Forway Aquamarine-General** (993) — Forway general and captain of the Sanbi embassy; close to the royals.
db15eca394d5.t: **洛芬吉·桑比·福威·阿夸马林将军**（993）——福威的将军，桑比大使馆的长官；与王室关系密切。

db79d55288e5.en: **Aurora Tolerideme** (988) — cheerful older maid at Sanbi Castle who still calls Tolerideme home.
db79d55288e5.t: **奥萝拉·托勒里德梅**（988）——桑比城堡里开朗的老女仆，仍把托勒里德梅当作家乡。

deb42bc3f3e1.en: **Lofingha Forway Amethyst-Captain** (1007) — young, short-tempered captain on a crusade against laziness.
deb42bc3f3e1.t: **洛芬嘉·福威·阿米西斯特队长**（1007）——年轻、脾气火爆的队长，正发起一场反懒惰的圣战。

e179e2b72cc3.en: Famous (and infamous) people of the 1040s, as the public knows them. They're here so DMs can drop them into sessions — **their novel storylines don't drive the campaign**. The DM decides who's alive and where. Birth years are A.G. Portraits are in the main repo under `Illustrations/Characters/`.
e179e2b72cc3.t: 1040年代的名人（和恶人），按公众所知的样子介绍。列在这里是为了让DM把他们放进游戏——**他们在小说中的故事线并不推动战役**。谁还活着、在哪里，由DM决定。出生年份为A.G.。肖像在主仓库的 `Illustrations/Characters/` 下。

e17c579e8f2a.en: **The princesses** — **Yacamim** (1015), the "Manly Princess", an adventurer engaged to Gandew's prince Hiromi after a tavern brawl; her identical twin **Maiara** (1015), even more brazen, star of Sanbi's Homeegg team; **Eori** (1021), the feminine one, gifted with soul energy and nari gels, wants to be a courtroom scientist; **Nina** (1032), tiny bundle of energy.
e17c579e8f2a.t: **公主们**——**娅卡敏**（1015），“男人婆公主”，冒险者，在一场酒馆斗殴后与甘杜的弘美王子订婚；她的同卵双胞胎妹妹**迈阿拉**（1015）更加大胆，是桑比霍姆埃格队的明星；**埃奥丽**（1021），最有女人味的那个，在灵魂能量和纳里凝胶方面很有天赋，想成为宫廷科学家；**妮娜**（1032），一个精力旺盛的小不点。

f21074ad568e.en: **Alford Tolerideme Dirt-Lover** (980) — the Farm King; brilliant farmer, narrow-minded, rumored to have a secret child. Partner **Luny** (997), a Forway-born courtroom scientist; jealous and opinionated.
f21074ad568e.t: **阿尔福德·托勒里德梅·达特拉弗**（980）——农场之王；出色的农夫，心胸狭窄，传说有个私生子。伴侣是**露妮**（997），生于福威的宫廷科学家；爱吃醋，主见很强。

f2b4c4214fed.en: **Posaqui Sanbi** (1023) — vain, blue-loving Amethyst adventurer who talks his way out of every fight.
f2b4c4214fed.t: **波萨基·桑比**（1023）——爱慕虚荣、偏爱蓝色的阿米西斯特冒险者，每场架都能靠嘴皮子脱身。

f7d38959e319.en: **Katsuki & Katsumi Flatland Long-Blue** (1017) — Wozefaries twins from the Goodbye Cliff.
f7d38959e319.t: **胜希与胜美·弗拉特兰·朗布卢**（1017）——来自再见崖的沃泽法里斯双胞胎。

fe3526e8a9f7.en: **Yosuke Forway Wood-People-Picker** (959) — grumpy Wozefaries chef of The Wood People Picker, a restaurant for the masses outside the gates. With line cook **Rimir** (1012) and the Flatland twins **Hanako** (Wozefaries) and **Mimi** (Sorefaries), both Goodbye Cliff survivors.
fe3526e8a9f7.t: **洋介·福威·伍德皮普尔皮克**（959）——城门外一家大众餐馆“伍德皮普尔采摘者”的脾气暴躁的沃泽法里斯厨师。和他一起的有厨工**里米尔**（1012）以及来自弗拉特兰的双胞胎**花子**（沃泽法里斯）和**咪咪**（索雷法里斯），两人都是再见崖的幸存者。
